svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.circle-axis-nonaxis-line-comparison", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Use real circular cutouts and reflection/folding to compare the two equal circles. The left vertical reference passes through the centre and is an axis of reflection; the right is parallel but offset by one-third of the16mm radius, so reflection in it moves the centre by10.6666667mm and does not map that circle to itself. Both references extend beyond their circle. Dashed1mm reference lines distinguish them from1.4mm boundaries in Swell/ViewPlus; Index uses sparser reference dots with deliberate junction guards. Reference/circle intersections are intentional; no touch or recognition result is claimed.", "geometry_exception": "Swell and ViewPlus share1.4mm boundaries,1mm references/diagonals and explicit dashed circle references. Native1.2mm Index dots follow the logical graph with single junction dots and recorded corner guards; circle reference dots are sparser than perimeter dots. All alternatives remain in the same master. No exact source reconstruction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots, not Braille. All vertices and intersections retain a single logical dot. Circle-reference sampling is sparser; polygon/diagonal junction guards and measured all-pairs clearance are explicit alternatives. Physical continuity remains pending.
